sources.system_use: Treat app skills, automations, sandboxing, and app/CLI continuity as the operating model for long-running GHC lane work.
Track remote-control, plugin JSON, app-server, and TUI command surfaces as compatibility queues.
Use build, scale, govern as the dashboard frame for helper runners and multi-agent infrastructure.
Package future helpers as narrow, independently gated service-like units.
Keep versioned compatibility, refresh cadence, and production-readiness notes in helper-runner receipts.
Preserve least-authority boundaries and confused-deputy avoidance across connectors, app lanes, CLI lanes, and repo writes.
Publish status-only operational evidence and avoid sensitive/private event data in receipts.
